definition.name: Twenty-four actual maintained objects with IPv4 routes and original reference owners

steps.name: Refuse mixed or unknown object profile inputs before acquisition or build
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
values = [os.environ[name] for name in ('NETLABEL_REQUEST', 'NETPORT_REQUEST', 'SIDCACHE_REQUEST', 'AVC_REQUEST', 'AUDIT_REQUEST', 'BIND_REQUEST', 'ROUTE_REQUEST')]
assert all(value in ('', 'true', 'false') for value in values)
assert values.count('true') <= 1
PY

steps.name: Install the existing locked Python recipe dependencies
Check exact config selection and private symbol oracles without a build
steps.run: python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_host_stream_kernel_objects tools.tests.test_host_stream_kernel_netlabel tools.tests.test_host_stream_kernel_netport tools.tests.test_host_stream_kernel_sidcache tools.tests.test_host_stream_kernel_avc tools.tests.test_host_stream_kernel_audit_skb tools.tests.test_host_stream_kernel_audit tools.tests.test_host_stream_kernel_bind tools.tests.test_host_stream_kernel_route -v

steps.name: Install only normal upstream Kbuild prerequisites
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes gcc make flex bison bc libelf-dev libssl-dev
